# NYAANO / न्यानो

NYAANO is a Nepali dairy brand being developed around two separate products: Cow Ghee and Buffalo Ghee.

## Core proposition
- Familiar local-style taste
- Cow and buffalo are clearly separate product identities
- Batch accountability and quality-control standards
- Tamper-evident packaged format
- Fair-price philosophy: an affordable trust premium, not luxury wellness pricing
- Brand philosophy: grow with farmers, manufacturers, retailers and customers rather than attacking competitors

## Claims policy
NYAANO should only publish quality, source, process, nutrition, organic, A2, grass-fed, bilona, health or superiority claims after they are verified for the actual commercial product.
